Plot the check of a fitted model against observed survival

Source: R/plot-check.R
plot_check.Rd

Draws the output of check_survival(): for each group, the proportion of individuals surviving in datasets simulated from the fitted model, as its median and band, with the proportion observed to survive as a stepped line over it. Where the model describes the data, the stepped line stays within the band. The result is a ggplot object, which can be refined by the user with further ggplot2 layers, scales, labels and themes.

Usage

plot_check(x, time_unit = NULL)

Arguments

x

A tibble, the output of check_survival().

time_unit

An optional character string giving the time unit for the axis label, e.g. "min". The fit does not record the unit of its times, so none is shown unless given.

Value

A ggplot object, with a panel per group.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plot_check(check_survival(fit), time_unit = "min")
} # }
